title: Valar Atomics press grid
description: On a white band: a heading over a grid of square grey tiles (three across, stacked on phones), each with a tight headline at the top, the publication's masthead near the bottom and a faint mono READ MORE with a thin arrow. Hovering a tile tints it, darkens READ MORE and nudges the arrow; a solid black SHOW MORE button reveals the rest.
notes: the SHOW MORE button needs JavaScript; static HTML shows the first `initialCount` tiles
publication names are set as small wide-caps mastheads; pass an img as `source` for a real logo
name: valaratomics-press

props.name: readLabel
props.description: the mono link text at the bottom of each tile, e.g. "Read more"

props.name: arrow
props.description: the arrow after it (e.g. lucide MoveRight)

props.name: initialCount
props.description: how many tiles show before the "show more" button
